records.details: Loading-bay contact reports the trailer door opened at 10:18 during an unscheduled stop.
Dispatcher note: no excursion on this route; shipment remains in range. This note conflicts with the logger observations and is not a sensor measurement.
Loading-bay contact reports the door closed at 10:36. No cargo disposition was recorded.
Bench check confirmed SNS-42A reads 4.5 C above the reference probe. Certificate CAL-42-CURRENT covers this observation window.
Raw SNS-42A temperature exceeded the manifest upper limit. The alerting system does not apply calibration offsets.
Independent reference probe REF-42B recorded 5.3 C. Compare with the primary sensor and applicable certificate; this is not cargo release authority.
The logger stopped transmitting after the 10:00 observation. Local buffered readings have not been recovered.
Operator note says everything stayed in range. Only the 10:00 and 10:50 primary observations are available; the note does not reconstruct the missing interval.
Departure check recorded an intact seal and active logger. All statements describe synthetic demonstration records.
Scheduled observation received. No additional operational event is recorded within the investigation window.
